messages:
alex.nguyen: Hi team, first day here! Trying to open Redwood Console (staging) and hitting a 403 on /admin/feature-flags. Anyone know who to ping for FF admin scope? I'm blocked on validating a canary rollout. :wave:
leah_infra: Welcome Alex! cc @jamie-peopleops. 403 usually means the SSO group mapping didn't include the admin role. Can you try incognito to rule out cached cookies and paste the exact path you hit?
alex.nguyen: path is https://console.staging.redwood.ai/admin/feature-flags — I can load the main console but that subpath 403s. Incognito same result.
leah_infra: OK. Quick check: run `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.staging.redwood.ai/api/v1/me` and look for the `groups` array — share the output (redact tokens). If you're only in `engineering` we need to add you to `platform-admins` or grant a temporary staging FF role.
alex.nguyen: I ran it, groups shows ["engineering"]. Not in any admin groups. How do I get added to platform-admins? Who owns that group?
jamie-peopleops: Hey — welcome! For short-term access we can grant a JIT staging admin role for ~8 hours. Sam (platform) usually approves these.
sam.platform: I can approve a temporary elevation. Alex, please open an onboarding ticket (ONB) with subject `staging-ff-admin` and include your manager + reason. I'll approve once the ticket exists.
alex.nguyen: Done — created ONB-4821 and added manager @maria.tan + notes about the canary test.
sam.platform: Approved. @onboarding-bot please run grant.
onboarding-bot: Granted `staging-ff-admin` to alex.nguyen for 8 hours. Audit id: AUD-20260323-1234.
alex.nguyen: Confirmed — I can now access /admin/feature-flags. Thanks! Quick follow-up: where's the runbook for safe canary rollouts so I follow the team's posture on gradual traffic, monitoring, and rollback?
leah_infra: See internal doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/feature-flags/canary-runbook — TL;DR: start at 1-2%, monitor latency + error budget for 15m, then 10% increments, set automatic rollback thresholds (e.g., error rate +50% or p95 latency +200ms). Use preview mode to validate targeting rules before enabling.
jamie-peopleops: If you want, I can walk through the checklist later today. Happy first day! :party_parrot:
sam.platform: FYI for prod FF admin we require a security review + manager sign-off; staging JIT is the right path for now. Keep ONB-4821 for audit.
alex.nguyen: Great — really appreciate the fast help. Tagging @maria.tan for visibility.
maria.tan: Thanks for the ping. Welcome aboard Alex — reach out if you want a quick pairing session on the canary metrics.
